layout: int16 little-endian; first rows*cols = elevation (m), next rows*cols = slope (tenths of a degree); row 0 = north
method: Slope from 20 m pixels (central differences, true ground spacing with cos(latitude)); 40 m cell = mean elevation, MAX slope of 2x2 block.

source.name: Mars 2020 Terrain Relative Navigation CTX DTM mosaic (20 m/px)
source.mission: MRO CTX (stereo), tied to MGS MOLA
